reference.name: inverse_scattering_reference
reference.basis: User-provided sdvae_model_finetune.py + kl_f8.yaml + debugpy launch configuration
reference.status: Corrected-code LWD adaptation; corresponding publication not identified
assumptions: Enable pretrained initialization explicitly; uploaded snapshot had vae_finetune=False.
Use the supplied LPIPS coefficient 1.0 instead of the snapshot wiring error args.kl_weight.
Preserve L1 + official AlexNet LPIPS v0.1 + summed KL, SGD and epoch-wise LitEma copyback.
Preserve the initial 10-epoch schedule: LPIPS coefficient is reduced after epoch 7; extending training does not move this milestone.
Use local official ImageNet AlexNet weights; frozen LPIPS is always in eval mode.
48x120 input, batch4 and float32 replace the supplied 64x64, batch64 and precision16 to fit the initial LWD workflow.

Dataset v2.2 uses a globally aligned y-z frame and a horizontal reference sequence with local anticlines and inclined fault offsets; isolated block/lens bodies are excluded. Tool inclination belongs to the forward model.
